text: ANDREY: subtasks must not eat space — from BIRD'S-EYE show task VOLUME compactly (N-subtasks badge/depth/density), expand to subtask cards only on zoom-drill. Use the canvas spatially (zoom=LOD). Folded into the zoom-drill brainstorm §25.

§25 synthesis (opus 5f5ac58f + cursor 9376b50e converged). PICKS: (1) LOD driver = appW (apparent on-screen size = cellWidth_world × cameraScale), NOT raw camera scale — each node bands by its own readable size. (2) RESERVE-AT-DEEPEST packing: cell sized at deepest-LOD bbox, content-LOD only changes what is painted → footprint fixed (§22.1), zero reflow, overlap structurally impossible. (3) Two orthogonal mechanisms: BAND (paint, zoom-only-per-node) ⊥ DOMINANCE (focus-assist, viewport-relative, elevate+dim, no footprint change, no auto-pan). Double-click stays the committed/locked twin.

Ladder (appW @280px cell): L0 GLYPH <150 = handle+status ring + step constellation + volume cue only. L1 THREAD 150-320 = labels + step thread w/ 1-line titles + roster chips. L2 CARDS 320-560 = step mini-cards + subtask fan-out + clamped body. L3 READING >560 = full bodies+step cards+subtask bodies+rationale+pane link. Crossfade = opacity + 4px rise, ±10% hysteresis, NO geometry reflow.

Integrated zoom-drill task content-LOD fix. Hot checkout gates: cards.test.tsx 17/17, npx tsc --noEmit, Playwright @content-lod and @canvas-multiview-overflow passed; @canvas-worlds-v3 skipped in current dev setup; CODETERM_API_PORT=7686 ./build.sh check; git diff --check.
